about: The right Amazon listing for each part of the validation set, labelled by an independent checker from the candidates' titles, brands and model numbers in the recorded responses (fixtures/validation/responses/amazon), never from Amazon pages or the tool's grades or chosen listings. Format: { labels: { "<bundle model>": { "<part model>": { "correct": ["<ASIN>", ...] | "none", "uncertain"?: ["<ASIN>", ...], "note": "<one line: why, with the source>" } } } }. correct lists every ASIN whose title names the part's model number (allowing RYOBI's tool-only B twin) from the same brand, sold new and alone (more than one when Amazon lists it twice); "none" when no recorded listing could be it; an empty list with uncertain when a listing might be it but its title does not settle it. Renewed, accessory, spare-part, "for Ryobi"/"compatible" and bundled listings are never the part; a part that is a kit is the kit sold whole, and a tool from a kit is that tool sold alone. core/test/validation.test.ts scores acceptance criterion 6 against correct only; uncertain is for a person to settle.
